verdict.rationale: Benchmark's own pricing page says its AI Assistant "crafts copy" right inside the email builder, which covers AI drafting of email copy in the composer. The evidence is a single marketing line and does not mention AI-generated subject lines, refining existing copy, or prompting from a brief. Missing for 10: AI subject-line generation, refine/rewrite of existing copy, brief-based prompting workflow, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer

citations.quote: AI Assistant crafts copy and creates images right inside the builder.
